stances.summary: Supporting Ukraine serves American security interests against Russian imperialism
stances.quote: It is in America’s interest to support Ukraine. If Russia can invade, subjugate, and pillage Ukraine with impunity, it will do the same again to others, and a world at war diminishes the security of Americans.

stances.summary: Accuses Tulsi Gabbard of spreading Russian propaganda that endangers lives
stances.quote: Tulsi Gabbard is parroting false Russian propaganda. Her treasonous lies may well cost lives.

stances.summary: Praises Zelensky's monumental courage and leadership during Ukraine conflict
stances.quote: Accounts of battlefield bravery have long inspired us. But the bravery of leaders of nations is often only witnessed in history or cinema—until now. I watch daily in awe at the monumental courage and leadership of @ZelenskyyUa. God bless him and instill within us such character.

stances.summary: Lauds Ukrainian heroes, soldiers, and journalists for bravery under Russian invasion
stances.quote: I join the world in awe of true heroes: the courageous President Zelensky, the brave Ukrainian soldiers, the citizen armies, the mothers cradling frightened children, and the journalists risking their lives to bring us truth. God bless them and God bless us to never forget.

stances.summary: Calls Navalny and Russian resisters courageous champions of truth and freedom
stances.quote: Alexei Navalny is the face of courage on the planet, as are the thousands of Russians who stand with him. Every champion of truth and freedom salutes them.

stances.summary: Trump's praise of MBS wrong; Congress must impose sanctions for Khashoggi murder
stances.quote: The President’s praise for MBS, the man who US intel says ordered or authorized the heinous murder of a WaPo columnist & Saudi dissident, sends the wrong message to the world. It’s past time for Congress & the administration to impose sanctions for the murder of Jamal Kha

stances.summary: Praises Lindsey Graham's support for Ukrainian freedom
stances.quote: Lindsey Graham’s dedication to the cause of freedom inspired the oppressed and chastened the tyrants. A most fitting tribute to his life will be the unwavering support for the people of Ukraine.

stances.summary: Defends Cheney and Kinzinger for seeking truth despite party censure
stances.quote: Shame falls on a party that would censure persons of conscience, who seek truth in the face of vitriol. Honor attaches to Liz Cheney and Adam Kinzinger for seeking truth even when doing so comes at great personal cost.

stances.summary: Expelling Cheney from leadership will cost GOP voters, not gain them
stances.quote: Expelling Liz Cheney from leadership won’t gain the GOP one additional voter, but it will cost us quite a few.

stances.summary: Defends conscience-driven refusal to lie; condemns party punishment for principle
stances.quote: Every person of conscience draws a line beyond which they will not go: Liz Cheney refuses to lie. As one of my Republican Senate colleagues said to me following my impeachment vote: “I wouldn’t want to be a member of a group that punished someone for following their conscience.”

stances.summary: Links Greene's conspiracy theories to the big lie of stolen election
stances.quote: Lies of a feather flock together: Marjorie Taylor Greene’s nonsense and the “big lie” of a stolen election.

stances.summary: Praises departing senator Cassidy's healthcare expertise and character
stances.quote: The Senate to now lose an exceptionally brilliant and creative mind, an MD who chairs healthcare, and a person of character. Bill Cassidy’s departure is a loss for the country.

stances.summary: Congratulates John Curtis on Senate election
stances.quote: Congratulations to Utah’s newest senator—@RepJohnCurtis! Our state is fortunate to have your continued service in Washington and the Senate is fortunate to have you. Wishing you and your team much success.

stances.summary: Criticizes lack of clear direction from Trump on government funding vote
stances.quote: What does President Trump want Republicans to do: vote for the CR or shut down government? Absent direction, confusion reigns.

stances.summary: Calls president's commutation of lying ally's sentence unprecedented historic corruption
stances.quote: Unprecedented, historic corruption:  an American president commutes the sentence of a person convicted by a jury of lying to shield that very president.

stances.summary: Trump's request for China and Ukraine to investigate Biden is wrong and appalling
stances.quote: By all appearances, the President’s brazen and unprecedented appeal to China and to Ukraine to investigate Joe Biden is wrong and appalling.

stances.summary: Trump singling out Biden for foreign investigation is politically motivated
stances.quote: When the only American citizen President Trump singles out for China’s investigation is his political opponent in the midst of the Democratic nomination process, it strains credulity to suggest that it is anything other than politically motivated.

stances.summary: Presidential pressure on Ukraine to investigate political rival would be troubling
stances.quote: If the President asked or pressured Ukraine’s president to investigate his political rival, either directly or through his personal attorney, it would be troubling in the extreme. Critical for the facts to come out.

stances.summary: Trump's divisive, demeaning comments fail his duty to unite Americans
stances.quote: The president’s comments were destructive, demeaning, and disunifying. The President of the United States has a unique and noble calling to unite the American people – of all different races, colors, and national origins. In that respect, the president failed badly.

stances.summary: Condemns assassination attempt as heinous and evil
stances.quote: Relieved the former President is safe and doing well. Outrageous and tragic that anyone would make such a heinous and evil act. Grateful for the quick response from Secret Service agents. This is a deeply sad day for America.

stances.summary: Calls for answers after tragic mass killing of children
stances.quote: Grief overwhelms the soul. Children slaughtered. Lives extinguished. Parents’ hearts wrenched. Incomprehensible. I offer prayer and condolence but know that it is grossly inadequate. We must find answers.

stances.summary: Condemns church shooting targeting fellow Latter-day Saints
stances.quote: Tragedy in Michigan as my brothers and sisters and their church are targets of violence. Praying for healing and comforting.

stances.summary: Condemns shooting incident as senseless violence
stances.quote: The shooting of Charlie Kirk has shocked and sickened me and my family. We extend our prayers and profound sorrow to Charlie and his family, many friends and followers. Another senseless act of violence appalls us.

stances.summary: John Lewis exemplified unwavering principle and character America needs
stances.quote: With the passing of John Lewis, America has lost not only a man of history, but a man for our season; O how we need such men of unwavering principle, unassailable character, penetrating purpose, and heartfelt compassion.

stances.summary: Affirms Black Lives Matter movement
stances.quote: Black Lives Matter. https://t.co/JpXUFlxH2J

stances.summary: Floyd murder abhorrent; peaceful protest justified but violence counterproductive
stances.quote: The George Floyd murder is abhorrent. Peaceful protests  underscore the urgency of addressing injustices. But violence drowns the message of the protestors and mocks the principles of justice.

stances.summary: Demands end to racist police abuse; Floyd's death must spark systemic change
stances.quote: No Americans should fear enmity and harm from those sworn to protect us. The death of George Floyd must not be in vain: Our shock and outrage must grow into collective determination to extinguish forever such racist abuse.

stances.summary: Shareholders lose deposits; depositors protected to prevent economic contagion
stances.quote: Silicon Valley Bank’s shareholders and executives lose it all, as they should. Depositors in good faith, however, should recover and have access to their deposits in order to meet their payrolls, pay their suppliers, and to prevent contagion.

stances.summary: Criticizes Democratic loan forgiveness as desperate bribery with economic risks
stances.quote: Desperate polls call for desperate measures: Dems consider forgiving trillions in student loans. Other bribe suggestions: Forgive auto loans? Forgive credit card debt? Forgive mortgages? And put a wealth tax on the super-rich to pay for it all. What could possibly go wrong?

stances.summary: Warns that untruths led to violence and death on January 6
stances.quote: I hope that I and others who come to the U.S. Capitol will remember that when we succumb to untruths as a nation, that it can lead to violence and even death as it did on January 6th. https://t.co/wuWkCCmcnO

stances.summary: Expresses sadness over Capitol Police Officer Billy Evans's death
stances.quote: Profound gratitude for those who protect our nation’s Capitol and who keep us safe, and profound sadness for Officer Billy Evans who has lost his life doing so.

stances.summary: Endorses Pope Francis legacy, expresses hope for successor
stances.quote: The world has been blessed by the voice and example of Pope Francis. May Pope Leo XIV likewise draw upon the best of humankind and lead toward the Savior, Jesus Christ.

stances.summary: Celebrates Jimmy Carter's faith, service, and democratic legacy
stances.quote: A man of character and deep faith, Jimmy Carter will be remembered as more than a president. He leaves behind a legacy of service to others, love of family, and devotion to country and democracy. He is home again, reunited with his beloved wife, Rosalynn.

stances.summary: Peaceful power transfer is fundamental; presidential refusal is unthinkable and unacceptable
stances.quote: Fundamental to democracy is the peaceful transition of power; without that, there is Belarus. Any suggestion that a president might not respect this Constitutional guarantee is both unthinkable and unacceptable.

stances.summary: Backs Israel and Ukraine defending against Iran, Russia; praises eliminations of Soleimani and Nasrallah
stances.quote: The Leader of the Free World must stand unequivocally with free nations defending themselves: Ukraine against the Russian invaders, Israel against Iran’s Hezbollah and Hamas. Soleimani and Nasrallah deserved their demise. Putin deserves our repudiation.

stances.summary: Praises women athletes' courage testifying about abuse; calls for institutional protection

stances.summary: Calls for urgent AI safeguards to prevent weapons, pathogens, unemployment, surveillance risks
stances.quote: Our highest and most urgent national priority should be AI safeguards. The risks of AI weapons, pathogens, mass unemployment, surveillance, and even extinction must not continue to be largely ignored.
